name: Rescue
description: Intelligent distress detection for falls, medical emergencies and help requests with family escalation and encrypted audit.
capabilities: Multimodal detection of falls, prolonged immobility, screams and distress calls
Immediate non-intrusive voice check-in before sounding alarm
Tiered escalation policy to family contacts and emergency responders
Tamper-proof encrypted audit in Sentinel journal with cryptographic proof

messages.alert_family: 🆘 Nuxiva Rescue Possible danger at home: {hazard}{who}. The person did not answer or asked for help. If you can, call them or go and check. If it is an emergency, call {number} now.
messages.alert_emergency: 🚨 Nuxiva Rescue, alert {round} Nobody has taken charge yet: {hazard}{who}. Call {number} now or go there.
messages.disclaimer: Nuxiva does not replace emergency services or a certified medical device.
messages.button_ack: 🏃 On my way, I'll handle it
messages.acked_by: ✅ {name} has taken charge of the alert.
messages.stand_down: Alert over: things look back to normal.
messages.callback_stale: This alert is no longer active.
messages.home_alarm: Warning: possible fire in the house. Get out now and call {number}.
messages.unreachable: Warning: Nuxiva detected a possible danger and cannot reach any family member. If help is needed, call {number}.
